request: Make the part symmetrical with respect to ZX plane by adding lowered plateau to the bottom. Then add embossed text to the top to distinguish the top (text should be "TOP", Arial, 10mm height, 1mm raised above lowered plateau, not sticking out of the plateau, approximately centered to the middle).

actions.operation: Create a lowered plateau on the bottom such that the resulting part geometry is symmetric about the ZX plane (implement as a bottom recessed pocket that mirrors the existing top recessed pocket).

parameters.footprint_definition: Mirror/copy of existing top pocket footprint (SEC_POCKET) projected onto bottom face

actions.target: Bottom side of the part (global bottom face) in the handle region between the ring-end and open-end heads
actions.relational_constraint: Final geometry must be symmetrical with respect to the ZX plane. The added bottom plateau must be the mirrored counterpart of the existing top pocket so that top-vs-bottom features are symmetric through the thickness.
actions.unresolved_reference: Confirm the model's ZX datum plane location. If the default ZX plane is not at the plate mid-thickness, create/use a mid-thickness datum plane (Y-mid) as the symmetry plane. If the intent is symmetry about the default ZX plane at y=0, then the part must be remodeled/repositioned; otherwise proceed assuming symmetry about the mid-thickness plane between top (face_code 0000) and bottom (face_code 0001).
steps: Establish the symmetry reference: define/use a mid-thickness datum plane parallel to ZX and located halfway between the global top face (face_code 0000, y=15) and global bottom face (face_code 0001, y=0). (If the CAD system’s default ZX plane is already this midplane, reuse it.)

Identify the existing top pocket geometry to mirror: use SEC_POCKET faces as the footprint reference (pocket floor face_code 0004; side walls 0005 and 0009; end walls 0007 and 0011; corner fillets 0006, 0008, 0010, 0012).

Create the bottom lowered plateau by feature mirroring (preferred, robust): Mirror the entire top pocket cut feature (SEC_POCKET) across the mid-thickness ZX symmetry plane to the bottom side. Ensure the mirrored feature is a CUT with the same depth (1mm) and corner fillets (R=1).
If direct feature-mirror is unavailable, recreate by sketch + cut on the global bottom face (face_code 0001):
a) Start a sketch on the bottom planar face (face_code 0001 / FACE 25).

b) Project/convert the top pocket perimeter into the sketch (project edges corresponding to the boundary between top face 0000 and pocket walls 0005/0009/0007/0011), or dimension the rectangle using the known wall locations (approx x≈-7.491 to x≈+6.945; z≈-97.400 to z≈-6.152).
c) Apply 4 sketch fillets radius 1mm at the pocket corners to match SEC_POCKET corner radii.
d) Perform an extruded cut of 1mm into the part (toward +Y from the bottom face), creating the bottom pocket floor at y=1mm; end condition: Blind = 1mm.

Validate symmetry: run a symmetry check by mirroring the full body about the chosen ZX symmetry plane and comparing/boolean intersecting; confirm the only difference previously (top pocket) is now balanced by the new bottom pocket, producing symmetric top/bottom detailing through thickness.

actions.operation: Add embossed (raised) text feature on the top recessed pocket floor using sketch text and a boss/extrude.
actions.target: Top side of the part, placed within the existing top recessed pocket (SEC_POCKET) so it does not protrude outside the pocket boundary in plan view
actions.relational_constraint: Text raised 1mm above the lowered plateau (top pocket floor). Text must not stick out of the plateau boundary (must be fully contained within the pocket perimeter). Text should be approximately centered to the middle of the pocket/part.
actions.unresolved_reference: Confirm whether 'middle' means the pocket center (recommended for containment) or the overall part centroid. If overall centroid is required, keep the text within the pocket by shifting only as far as allowed by pocket boundaries. Confirm whether 'not sticking out' refers only to plan-view containment or also to height (recommended: extrude 1mm from pocket floor so the text top is flush with the global top face).
steps: Select the pocket floor face as the sketch plane: pocket floor (face_code 0004 / FACE 1, planar at y=14).
Create a new sketch on face_code 0004.
Insert sketch text: content = "TOP"; font = Arial; text height = 10mm. Set text as a closed profile suitable for boss extrusion.

a) Define construction centerlines in the sketch aligned with the pocket’s midlines (midpoint between pocket long walls face_codes 0005 and 0009, and midpoint between pocket end walls face_codes 0007 and 0011).
b) Constrain the text’s bounding box center to the intersection of these midlines (pocket center), yielding an approximately centered placement.

c) Verify containment: ensure the entire text outline stays inside the pocket perimeter with a small margin to the pocket walls (do not cross the projected edges corresponding to pocket walls 0005/0009/0007/0011). If needed, slightly reduce text width via tracking/spacing or adjust placement while keeping height at 10mm.

Create the emboss as a boss extrusion from the pocket floor: extrude the text profile +1mm (toward +Y). Preferred end condition for robustness: 'Up to Face' selecting the global top face (face_code 0000 / FACE 24) so the raised text ends flush with the original top surface and is exactly 1mm above the pocket floor.
Boolean: Join/merge the embossed text solid with the base part.

Final check: confirm the embossed text is fully inside the pocket footprint in top view, and that the maximum text height does not exceed the global top face (i.e., it does not protrude above y=15 if using 'Up to Face').

intention: Make the part symmetric about the ZX plane by balancing the existing top recessed pocket with an equivalent mirrored bottom recessed plateau, improving visual/functional symmetry through thickness.
Visually distinguish/mark the top side by adding a readable "TOP" emboss contained within the top pocket so it is protected and does not extend beyond the pocket boundary.
